# authwise_certificate (Resource)

A certificate and, when kit minted it, its private key. The trust anchor SAML connections verify signatures against, and the client certificate an endpoint presents for mTLS.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String)
- `use` (String)

### Optional

- `import_certificate_pem` (String) `import_certificate_pem` is input only: the API consumes it and never returns it, so it is never refreshed from the server and an imported resource has no value for it.
- `key_size` (Number) `key_size` is input only: the API consumes it and never returns it, so it is never refreshed from the server and an imported resource has no value for it.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `status` (String)
- `subject_common_name` (String) `subject_common_name` is input only: the API consumes it and never returns it, so it is never refreshed from the server and an imported resource has no value for it.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `validity_days` (Number) `validity_days` is input only: the API consumes it and never returns it, so it is never refreshed from the server and an imported resource has no value for it.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_pem` (String)
- `fingerprint_sha256` (String)
- `has_private_key` (Boolean)
- `key_id` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `not_after` (String) `not_after` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `not_before` (String) `not_before` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `origin` (String)
- `subject` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
# The mint and import parameters are input-only, so an imported certificate has no value for them.
terraform import authwise_certificate.example tenants/t-01/certificates/cert-01
```
